body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group CEO) on the Q3FY26 call (2026-02-10), prompted: "One of our customers over there was waiting for their IMMEX registration which has now come through in this quarter. So, hopefully, those supplies will start from the next quarter." Metric: Mexico supplies start. Target: First supplies in Q1FY27. Deadline: 2026-06-30 (quarter). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: MISSED. Evidence: Slipped about 2 quarters: Aug-26 call moved first deliveries to Q3FY27; dispatch began Nov-2026 (Q2FY27 call, 2026-11-05). New date given unprompted in the Aug-26 opening remarks, but framed as on track rather than as a slip. Management explanation: Other customers still ramping their own requirements.
